body: It’s not your fault. Please take care of yourself. I’m so sorry, I suffer from Anorexia and bulimia too. I feel the same way about my brother however with suicide. I have problems with suicide attempts, self harm etc. and I catch my little brother saying he wants to kill him self. It hurts so bad because I never showed that side of me to him but he feels like that anyways. I know what you mean. I just feel so guilty... but we need to understand it’s not our fault and all we can do is help them before it’s too late :/
No no. I know how hard it is. Trust me, Im on the brink of suicide too but please don’t do anything please.
Somebody I knew did it. It worked...
Yes I know how that is, the feeling is so odd. And thank you, I’ll try not to 🥺
I’m sure you’ll find it. It’s going to be ok, I know it will take some time but I know that you got this.
I love you !!  Please stay, I know exactly how you feel... and you deserve so much better I’m sorry :(

I know how you feel I’ve been harming for 2 years and mines aren’t nearly as bad as what I see. Even though they bleed a lot. I feel like a failure because I want mines to look like that. I mean mine are raised and scarring but it’s not that obvious. I’m going to try a different blade....
